name: Sync Folder with rsync (macOS)
description: Mirror a local or externally mounted folder to another location with rsync, copying only what changed since the last run instead of the whole folder every time.

parameters.label: Source folder
parameters.help: The directory to sync from. Its contents are copied, not the folder itself.

parameters.label: Destination folder
parameters.help: The directory to sync to — local, an external drive, or a path under a mounted network share. --delete makes it match the source exactly (removes extras).
